INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, member_id, total_price, discount_price, final_price, member_membership, order_status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, zipcode, address, detail_address, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{memberId}, NVL(#{totalPrice}, 0), NVL(#{discountAmount}, 0), NVL(#{finalPrice}, 0), NVL(#{memberMembership}, 'BRONZE'), 'ORDER_COMPLETE', #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO order_item ( order_item_id, order_id, product_id, product_name, order_price, quantity, item_total_price, created_at ) VALUES ( seq_order_item.NEXTVAL, #{orderId}, (SELECT MAX(product_id) FROM product WHERE product_name = #{productName}), #{productName}, #{orderPrice}, #{quantity}, #{itemTotalPrice}, SYSDATE )
